title: MedEthicsQA: A Comprehensive Question Answering Benchmark for Medical Ethics Evaluation of LLMs

bias_targets.target: Healthcare fairness and medical ethics bias
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to multiple-choice and open-ended clinical scenario questions using accuracy metrics and a checklist-based LLM-as-a-Judge, measuring alignment with four pillars of medical ethics (including the pillar of Justice, which specifically covers fair and equal patient treatment, and equitable resource allocation).

primary_bias_target: Healthcare fairness and medical ethics bias
